### Method 1: Archive a Chat in ChatGPT (To Hide from Sidebar)

If you want to clear a chat from your active sidebar without deleting it:

1. Open [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTwHEIkXXWfzSBp58bW2wDKKByOnumvBuxXVfVVlxzyxq6wG2F9QTDG7fyvFvnMZPGZpVSktDcKugQYGUD5r8DKi5Dvf7aAgpfjTRsyOm3FY) and sign in.
2. Hover over or click the **three dots (`•••`)** next to the conversation in your left-hand sidebar.
3. Select **Archive**. *(You can view your archived chats later in your account settings).* [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXwYTjIKuNolKKcYnxnCdamc1MqUjGVLxUDCiaZbeAj26tFrmRMvTjrCiYNm4UjCAV4ybEOoFtMTYqgtd2PgVdmbZJMbFjVtKP7plOIezqOcmB7rRXXp_A54olRbjnyDnUFeewiz9eVgfdL9Wh6RsLvSG1gwE1UZ65)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF18CZCJBgzBYxLzgyUXz1GuUYXuX-2qsOBOF-rCvlPDYz4UcJUZV2poQLcy8573_bKcj0FiLSI1dXEWP4eEuzq-cbblmVCjMmamAN4nq1O4Lrn3pdnwDvTRnmkhVj9faX3g6yiBd1sSvpYFLyZu_EZAXmJlgxxGekOUL6u139F5hgkGdc3hqzfZoIlQ)

### Method 2: Save a Single Chat as a PDF

To save an individual conversation quickly to your computer:

1. Open the specific conversation in ChatGPT.
2. Press **`Ctrl + P`** (Windows) or **`Command + P`** (Mac) to open the print dialog.
3. Change the destination printer to **Save as PDF**.
4. Adjust the layout options if needed, then click **Save** and pick a folder on your computer.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rV8Q4ND9qgk)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KNa7p9mhTyI&t=9)

If you want a complete backup of all your conversations, user profile data, and custom instructions:

4. Click **Confirm export**.
